name: DITTO-NeRF
aliases: Diffusion-based Iterative Text To Omni-directional 3D Model
definition: A pipeline to generate a high-quality 3D NeRF model from a text prompt or a single image. It constructs a high-quality partial 3D object for limited in-boundary (IB) angles and iteratively reconstructs the remaining 3D NeRF using inpainting latent diffusion model.
summary: DITTO-NeRF generates high-quality 3D NeRFs from text or images by combining partial 3D construction with iterative latent diffusion inpainting, offering higher fidelity and efficiency than DreamFusion.
